notes: Own witness from the read lineage-reads-1985/g-01.json: the reader showed the compiler correct at 85 with its probe (p6_alnum.cob), placed as the row's own test; its expected output is the reader's judged run, equal on this build. The read: "Any character in the computer's character set": the probe stores each of the 256 characters in a PIC X item and reads its ordinal back. DOC-A.1-31 (2023 implementor-defined coded character set) documents the set, it does not say an alphanumeric character is any member of it. Code location located after the read: CobolString stores and holds alphanumeric characters, accepting any character of the computer character set (each of the 256 ordinals round-trips).
